page.layout: One printed page (left, p. 232) of running text with Greek words and references; a narrow column of marginal notes on the right edge, partly cut off by the binding and the page edge.

main_text.p: tus Luc. 23. v.9. magnus Actor. 20. v.37. & 22. 6. aptus 2. Tim.2. 2. Luc.23. v.8. ἐξ ἱκανῶν scil. χρόνῳ a multo tempore, Actor.20. v.11. ἐφ᾽ ἱκανὸν diu, Act.17. 9. λαβεῖν τὸ ἱκανὸν satis accipere, phrasis juridica, cujus relat. satis dare.
Ἱκανότης ητος ἡ idoneitas, quod idonei sumus, 2.Cor.3.5.
Ἱκανόω ῶ idoneum reddo. Fut. ώσω. P. ἱκανωμαι. a.1. ἱκανωσα 2.Cor.3.6.
Ἱκετηρία ας ἡ supplicatio, ab ἱκέτης ὁ supplex, Heb.5.7.
Ἵλεως ω ὁ ἡ Attice pro ἵλαος. à Themate ἱλάω & ἱλήμι propitius sum. mitericors, Matth. 10.22.
Ἱλάσκομαι vel ἱλάομαι propitius fio. F. ἱλάσομαι. prat.pass. ἱλάσθμαι. a.1.pass.imperat. ἱλάσθητι propitius esto, cum Dat. Luc.18.13.
Ἱλαστήριον τὸ propitiatorium, operculum arca federis, Rom.3.25.
Ἱμὰς ἀντὸς ὁ corrigia, lorum. Dat. pl. ἱμᾶσι, Marc.1.7.
Ἱμάτιον τὸ vestimentum, Matth.5.4. pro εἱμάτιον ab εἵματος τὸ vestis. Th. ἕννυμι ἵσω induo. prat.pass. εἵμαι indutus sum.
Ἱματίζω vestio. F. ἱσω. P. ἱματίσμαι. prat.pass. ἱματισμαι.

page.notes: The right margin is cut off and heavily damaged; its fragments (e.g. "part.brit", "Matth", "Joh", "Judae", "equites") are too incomplete to transcribe reliably and are omitted. Greek accents and breathings in the main text are reproduced as best read; several Greek words were read with [?]-level uncertainty and may contain errors.
